card.title: 60th INFANTRY REGIMENT
card.text: When this unit is fully repaired, add a copy of it to your support line.
card.flavorText: The 60th Infantry Regiment, nicknamed “Go Devils”, was a regiment of the US Army and was first formed in 1917 during WWI. The regiment was deactivated in 1921, but reactivated in 1940 and assigned to the 9th Infantry Division. In 1942 the 60th Regiment was sent to North Africa to take part in Operation Torch, which was the Allied invasion of French Morocco. In 1943 it participated in the Allied invasion of Sicily where the men of the regiment managed to infiltrate the German lines and clear out the last resistance. In 1944 the regiment was part of the Allied invasion of Normandy and would see heavy fighting during the Allied liberation of France and the lower countries. The regiment fought in the Battle of the Bulge and would later fight in various battles and operations in the Allied push towards Germany. The 60th would end the war in Germany where it was on occupation duty until it was deactivated in 1946, but reactivated shortly thereafter and has been active to the present day.
